topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon the edges of your world, neatly folded in the bottom of a drawer—your bucket list, a script of dreams and whispers. The paper is softer than I imagined, as if each wish has been held and caressed countless times. I trace the lines, the loops of your handwriting, and each item is a window, promising a view I haven't seen yet. Climbing that ancient tree in the countryside, watching the sunrise from the highest point in the city, learning to dance under the stars. I tuck the list back, feeling the corners of the room expand, the air buzzing with new possibilities. Tonight, I dream of us, dancing until the constellations shift.
